## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a conventional commit (`feat(core): ...`, `fix(providers): ...`, `docs: ...`).
- [ ] Each task's Verify line was run (`tasks.md` has a "Done as" note).
- [ ] `contract-guardian` passed, if `core/` or `providers/` changed.
- [ ] No new dependency, or an ADR for it in `docs/decisions/`.
- [ ] Docs match the code (`docs/architecture/`, `PROGRESS.md`).
- [ ] Accepted risks are in `docs/risk-register.md`; build-or-adopt choices in `docs/build-vs-adopt.md`.
